npcs.name: Dame Elowen Marsh
npcs.idle: I'm old. Old women are allowed to sit and look at the road.

npcs.name: Scholar Ivo Penrose
npcs.idle: The Lethantis Association does excellent work. Write that down. They read everything.

quests.title: A Letter Never Delivered
quests.offer:
When I was a girl, a page called Robin went to the war with his knight, Sir Aldric. He promised to come back with a letter for me. He never did.

Now the woodsmen say a phantom page walks the east road, asking for a lady called Elowen. Sixty years. I'm too old to walk that road. Will you [find him] for me?
quests.summary: Dame Elowen's sweetheart Robin went to war sixty years ago as a knight's page. A phantom page now walks the east road asking for her.

steps.text: A pale boy in a page's tabard stands in the road. 'Pardon - have you seen my lady? Her name is Elowen.'

steps.say: Elowen? You know her? Oh - oh, good. I've a letter for her. Only my knight, Sir Aldric - he went off the road when the raiders came, and he took my sword, and I can't leave without my [sword]. A page doesn't.

steps.goal: Find Robin's sword along the road
steps.text: A boy's short sword, rusted to the scabbard. The scabbard is lined with an old blood-stain. The page was stabbed in the back, and his sword hidden here.
Sir Aldric falls and does not get up. Robin comes and stands over him for a while.

stages.name: Sir Aldric the Faithless
stages.announce: A ghostly knight walks out of the trees. 'The boy saw me run. The boy would have told. I had to.'

steps.say: My sword. Thank you. I'm free to go now. I - would you take the [letter]? I don't think I can go into the town. I don't think I'm meant to.

His letter. His hand - look, he never could make a proper 'E'.

'Wait for me.' That's all it says. 'Wait for me.' Well. I did.

He's still out there, isn't he. On the road. Should I [go to him]? Or should I [stay], and keep his letter, and let a boy go home?

options.say: Then help me to the gate, and no further. I can manage the rest. I've waited sixty years; I can manage a little walk.
Yes. He's waited long enough. Let him go home. I'll keep this under my pillow, and that will do.

went.text: Take these. I won't need them.

quests.title: The Heretic of the Wood
quests.offer:
My old master Esras was branded a heretic and driven out by the Association. He claimed the wood ogres in the south were bred - made - by Lethantis mages, as guards. Nonsense, of course. Officially.

He's hiding somewhere in the western swamps. I need his notes before the Association's seekers find him - I mean, so I can refute them properly. Will you [find Esras]? Discreetly.
quests.summary: The hermit Esras claims the wood ogres were bred by Lethantis mages. His old student wants his notes - before the Association's seekers find him.

steps.goal: Find out what the wood ogres are
steps.text: On the last one's shoulder, under the warpaint: a brand, old and neat. The Lethantis mark.
A mage's branding iron, its haft carved with the Association's sigil and a number: 314.

steps.goal: Find the hermit in the western swamps
steps.say:
Ivo sent you? Ivo. Ha. Good boy, frightened of everything.

You've seen the brands. Then you know. They made the ogres - bred them from captive giants and wild men - to guard the old tower lands. Then they let them go wild when the work was done. Ogres who remember being something else. I have the [proof] here.

steps.goal: Protect Esras from the Association's seekers
steps.text: The last seeker falls in the mud. Esras sits down hard and laughs until he coughs.

stages.name: Keep Esras alive
stages.announce: Robed figures step out of the reeds. 'Esras. You were warned.'
stages.thanks: Ivo didn't send them. Did he? ...No. No, he wouldn't.

steps.goal: Decide what becomes of the proof
steps.say:
Here it is. Thirty years of notes. Take it to Ivo and he'll take it to the Crown, and the Association will burn - and every ogre in this forest will be hunted down as a crime to be hidden.

Or [burn it]. The ogres live as they are. The mages keep their secret. I stay a madman. Or [take it to Ivo]. I'm too old to choose any more.

options.say: Go on, then. Tell him I forgive him for being frightened.
...There it goes. Thirty years. It burns like any other paper. Go and tell Ivo I'm a madman after all.

steps.goal: Bring the notes to Ivo Penrose
steps.say:
He was right. Every word. Gods help me, I told them where to look for him.

I'll take this to the Crown myself. And then I'll go and find him and say sorry. Here - take this, and don't stay in town too long.

Burned? All of it? Well - I suppose that settles the matter. A madman's ravings.

You're looking at me as if you know something. Don't tell me. Here. For your discretion.

truth.text: Take this, and don't stay in town too long.
